tools.title: Custom API tools
tools.description: Let agents call your HTTPS endpoints with validated inputs, strict egress rules and confirmations.
tools.createDescription: Describe the endpoint, its JSON schemas and how risky its effects are.
tools.emptyDescription: Add a tool to let agents look up orders, create tickets or call other systems.

form.serverIssues: The tool could not be saved:
form.name: Tool name
form.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, e.g. lookup_order.
form.descriptionHint: Explain when the agent should use this tool and what it returns.
form.baseUrlHint: Public HTTPS origin. Private and internal addresses are blocked.
form.pathHint: Wrap placeholder names in curly braces; they must match input schema properties.
form.sideEffectHint: Tools that change data require stronger confirmation.
form.secretHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

errors.name: Use 3–64 lowercase letters, numbers or underscores, starting with a letter.
errors.base_url: Enter an HTTPS URL of 10 to 300 characters.
errors.path_template: The path must start with / and contain only URL-safe characters.
errors.bearer_secret: Bearer tokens need 16–4096 printable characters without spaces.
errors.hmac_secret: HMAC secrets need 32–512 printable characters without spaces.

messaging.title: Messaging
messaging.description: Confirmations to your guests are sent from your own email address and in your name.

sms.name: SMS notifications
sms.description: A short confirmation text to guests when a booking is made, changed or canceled.
sms.onHint: On: guests also get a text message when they gave their phone number.

email.name: Email system
email.description: Your guests receive their confirmations from this address.
email.disconnectDescription: Until a new email system is set up, guests will not receive email confirmations. The stored password is deleted immediately.
email.connected: Email system set up and the test connection succeeded
email.testSent: We sent a test email to {email}
email.emptyHint: Not set up yet. Until you connect it, guests will not receive email confirmations.
email.dialogDescription: Your sign-in details are stored encrypted and only used to send emails to your guests.
email.googleDescription: The quickest way: sign in to your Google account and you are done. No password needed.
email.securityHint: Port 465 uses SSL/TLS, port 587 uses STARTTLS.
email.passwordHint: With Gmail and 2-step verification, create an app password in your Google account security settings.
email.fromNameHint: The name guests see, for example your business name.
email.replyToHint: Optional. Guest replies go here when it differs from the sender address.
